description: Manus's desktop agent through its cask.
why: Manus also matches on the brew route, so must_find would pass with its bundle id broken; must_contain names im.manus.desktop for that reason. Nothing is forbidden: no catalogued agent shares a value or a namespace with Manus, and test_matcher holds its helper's id apart.
known_gaps: Manus is never launched: its computer-use and capture helpers, which its cask's uninstall stanza names as launchd jobs, are never registered, so no launchd value is read.
Manus's Windows build is not installed anywhere.
